Strategy: Add an exact-fit bonus on top of the gentle fifteen narrow sweet band from thirty-two to forty-two with the mid penalty. This combines three preferences that each helped alone, but the narrow band may rarely engage.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if r - item >= 32 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
